title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
subtitle: 考点：情态动词 / We can reduce, reuse and recycle

dialogue.t: Sam, what are you doing with those old bottles?
I am going to reuse them.
I will paint them and make pen holders.
Paper, cans and plastic bottles. We can reduce, reuse and recycle!
I will put my old paper in the recycling box.
Great! Every small step makes a difference.

vocab: reduce 减少 · reuse 再利用 · recycle 回收 · bottle 瓶子 · paper 纸 · difference 差别

questions.stem: What will Sam do with the old bottles?
questions.why: I will paint them and make pen holders.

questions.stem: What will Lily put in the recycling box?
questions.why: I will put my old paper in the recycling box.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: Sam will throw the bottles away.
